goals: Triage all GPS auto-verification outcomes for zone (CLOSED/PARTIAL_RECOVERY/FAILED_VERIFICATION incl. fraud-flag) on one page
Investigate fraud-flagged outcomes (Phase-1 distance delta) and escalate
Mark recovered devices CLOSED_AUTO_RECOVERY so auto-recovery is never credited as SE repair
scopeNote: SE has a passive Verification Result screen (mobile, outcome badge only, per-ticket, PRD:490) — receives the same outcome, cannot act on it. Verification Review's PRD stories (37-41) are 100% ZM-voiced; SE is not a second persona hiding here, just a read-only downstream receiver. Separate boundary disagreement (not resolved here): PRD frames escalate as staying inside Verification Review; SPINE E-10 shows escalate action's receiver screens are /tickets and /reports/root-cause, i.e. verification module hands off rather than owning the escalation queue.

capabilities.name: single-page outcome review (CLOSED/PARTIAL_RECOVERY/FAILED_VERIFICATION/fraud) per zone
capabilities.why: no single triage view means ZM checks tickets one by one; escalation-worthy failures get missed under daily ticket volume

capabilities.name: PARTIAL_RECOVERY ping-count + 24h-escalation countdown
capabilities.why: no visible countdown means recovering devices silently blow through the 24h window with no ZM action

capabilities.name: fraud-flag highlight with Phase-1 distance delta
capabilities.why: this is the module's judge-the-work function; without the delta shown ZM cannot separate genuine device failure from a submission-location mismatch — the DANGEROUS class this module exists to catch

capabilities.name: escalate action from a flagged/failed outcome
capabilities.why: E-10: escalate route exists (POST /verification/:ticketId/escalate) but no un-escalate reverse — without the forward action working the flagged row is a dead end, no compliance follow-through

capabilities.name: FAILED_VERIFICATION split: no-pings vs fraud-flag reason
capabilities.why: unsplit reasons force ZM to open each ticket to learn device-silent vs suspected-fraud, misdirecting escalation effort at volume

capabilities.name: manual mark CLOSED_AUTO_RECOVERY
capabilities.why: without this control, an auto-recovered device gets miscredited as an SE repair — corrupts SE scorecards and root-cause reports downstream (E-28)

capabilities.name: outcome tie-back into a finished-work ledger for reports
capabilities.why: brief names O1 (no finished-work ledger) and P3 (no reconciliation) as the risk classes here; without a persisted outcome→report link, 'did the work actually happen' can't be audited after the fact — only live-triage exists
